writer.name: 米尔恰·达内柳克 Mircea Daneliuc

director.name: 米尔恰·达内柳克 Mircea Daneliuc

playdate: 2015-11(希腊（塞萨洛尼基国际电影节）)
introduction: Naita Lucean, a smart and stubborn peasant, opposes collectivization by all means. He instinctively feels that this can only bring him harm, since he would cede the land and cattle raised with so much effort to the state.Director and screenwriter Mircea Daneliuc, with co-author Dinu Sararu, set this story of the peasants' resistence to land reform in the 1950s in Rumania against snatches of historical events that led up to this moment in time, and against the complicated individuals who were chosen by history to either carry out or defy the reforms. As has been said many times before, hindsight is always 20/20, which made it much easier to film this story with a balanced perspective three decades after the fact.
